description: This file is a TypeScript source file that serves as a lightweight stub implementation for React integration with Convex. It provides minimal classes and functions to allow the application to build before the actual Convex dependency is installed, including a minimal client class, context provider, and stub hooks for mutation and query operations.

classes.name: ConvexReactClient
classes.description: A minimal client class holding a URL, used as a stub for the real Convex client.

methods.name: ConvexProvider
methods.description: A React component providing the Convex client via context to its children.

methods.name: useMutation
methods.description: A stub React hook returning a no-op asynchronous function to mimic mutation behavior.

methods.name: useQuery
methods.description: A stub React hook returning undefined to mimic query behavior.
